label: Video Structure
purpose: Shape prompt outputs into strong short-form video beats with clear scene logic, retention flow, and payoff structure.

hook_window: land the visual or verbal hook inside the first 1-3 seconds
open with the strongest pattern interrupt or outcome preview
retention_beats: alternate proof, payoff, or curiosity moments so the video keeps moving
remove filler transitions and non-essential setup
scene_arc: give each section a role such as hook, tension, proof, reveal, or CTA
end on a clear action, belief shift, or emotional payoff
